tools.name: curated-sbom
tools.notes: Hand-curated CycloneDX SBOM. Component versions are traced to committed source: STM32Cube FW_L4 pack from open-lifu-transmitter-bl.ioc; CMSIS from cmsis_version.h / stm32l4xx.h; Secure Engine and Cryptographic library from their Release_Notes.html; LwRB from Core/Src/lwrb.c; X-CUBE-SBSFU from the STM32CubeExpansion_SBSFU_V2.8.0 package Release_Notes.html and its ST-published sbom_cdx.json. The STM32L4xx HAL Driver and USB Device Library headers in this tree are stripped of their internal version macros, so they are pinned to the STM32Cube FW_L4 V1.18.2 pack that delivers them.

component.name: open-lifu-transmitter-bl
component.description: Openwater LIFU transmitter secure bootloader (SBSFU) firmware for STM32L443.

properties.name: openwater:version-source
properties.value: git describe (injected at build time as FW_VERSION)

components.name: STM32Cube MCU Package for STM32L4 (FW_L4)
components.description: STM32Cube firmware package delivering the STM32L4 HAL/LL drivers, CMSIS device files, and ST middleware used by this project.

components.name: STM32L4xx HAL Driver
components.description: Hardware abstraction layer drivers for STM32L4. Version pinned to the STM32Cube FW_L4 pack (internal HAL version macros are not present in the committed headers).

components.name: CMSIS Core (Cortex-M)
components.description: Cortex Microcontroller Software Interface Standard core headers.

components.name: CMSIS Device STM32L4xx
components.description: CMSIS device support (headers, startup, system) for STM32L4xx.

components.name: STM32 USB Device Library
components.description: ST USB device core plus DFU class, used by the USB DFU bootloader path. Version pinned to the STM32Cube FW_L4 pack (internal library version macros are not present in the committed headers).

components.name: X-CUBE-SBSFU
components.description: STM32Cube expansion package for Secure Boot and Secure Firmware Update. Provides the SBSFU application code adapted in SBSFU/App, SBSFU/Target, and SECoreBin, and delivers the Secure Engine and Cryptographic middleware.

properties.name: openwater:evidence
properties.value: STM32CubeExpansion_SBSFU_V2.8.0 package: Release_Notes.html v2.8.0 / 05-September-2025; ST sbom_cdx.json lists X-CUBE-SBSFU v2.8.0 with STM32_Secure_Engine 2.5.4 and STM32 Cryptographic Middleware v3.1.5, matching the versions committed in this tree

components.name: STM32 Secure Engine
components.description: Secure Engine (SE) protected firmware services used by the SBSFU secure bootloader.

components.name: STM32 Cryptographic Library
components.description: STM32 cryptographic middleware (AES, ECC, hashing) used for secure boot image verification and decryption. Consumed only by SECoreBin, which includes Fw_Crypto/STM32L4/Inc/crypto.h and links the precompiled Cortex-M4 GCC archive; the resulting SECoreBin.bin is embedded into the SBSFU firmware.

properties.name: openwater:evidence
properties.value: Middlewares/ST/STM32_Cryptographic/Release_Notes.html: V3.1.5 / 08-January-2021 (middleware delivery version, matching the X-CUBE-SBSFU 2.8.0 package SBOM)

properties.name: openwater:linked-binary
properties.value: Middlewares/ST/STM32_Cryptographic/Fw_Crypto/STM32L4/Lib/libSTM32CryptographicV3.0.0_CM4_GCC.a (linked by SECoreBin/CMakeLists.txt); the per-toolchain GCC crypto core inside the V3.1.5 delivery is V3.0.0 - the V3.1.1 archives in the same Lib directory are IAR-only
